clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —  Requirements for coarse aggregate prepared from broken bricks (burnt clay) for use in lime concrete.

clauses.title: Quality
clauses.text: 2. Quality —  Shall be prepared from the well/ overburnt bricks conforming to class designation 50 and above  of IS 1077:1992.* It shall be free from underburnt clay particles, soluble salt and adherent coating of soil or silt. Brick aggregate should be handled least number of times before being used in concrete.

clauses.title: Grading for broken brick coarse aggregate
clauses.text: 3.1 Grading for broken brick coarse aggregate -shall be as  fallows — IS Sieve Percent  Passing Designation (By Mass) 75  mm 100 37.5 mm 95-100 19.0 mm 45- 75 4.75 mm 0- 5

IS 5640: 1970 Methods of test for determining aggregate impact value of soft coarse aggregates.
